answer: Bond of 500 POA per identity, capped at one bond per identity per epoch, locked 30 epochs. A 1,000-identity farm locks 500,000 POA and waits 30 closes for its first payout; honest work covers the bond in 3 epochs at the median 170 POA. At each unlock a lantern check re-reads funding history, and any two claimants sharing a source get a saffron flag and count as one island. Attack cost: 500,000 POA dead for 30 epochs.
